product_contract.adoption_state: PC31/PC32 application backup center adopts Core backup and restore task submission, exposes path-free backup/restore evidence, and binds trusted deployment workers to the registered production source and isolated restore target
product_contract.security_boundary: client input is limited to the registered provider key, opaque backup reference and registered logical restore target; host, database, path, command, credential and retry count remain deployment-owned

backups.capacity_requirement: immediately before backup, available bytes at the target must exceed twice the current mysql-data and php-storage source bytes plus 1 GiB, with sufficient inode headroom

write_quiescence.stop: ssh -o BatchMode=yes oracle3 'cd /www/docker/peanut-admin && sudo -n docker compose -f compose.yaml --profile bundled-db stop --timeout 60 nginx cron php'
write_quiescence.verify: ssh -o BatchMode=yes oracle3 'cd /www/docker/peanut-admin && test "$(sudo -n docker compose -f compose.yaml --profile bundled-db ps --status running --services | sort)" = mysql'
write_quiescence.resume: ssh -o BatchMode=yes oracle3 'cd /www/docker/peanut-admin && sudo -n docker compose -f compose.yaml --profile bundled-db start --wait --wait-timeout 120 php cron nginx'
write_quiescence.failure_policy: the deployment owner must restore php, cron and nginx before leaving a failed gate; incomplete backup directories are not eligible for restore or deployment evidence

backup_method.prepare: install -d -m 0700 /www/docker/peanut-admin/backups/<backup_id> before entering the write-quiescence window
backup_method.database_dump: cd /www/docker/peanut-admin && sudo -n docker compose -f compose.yaml --profile bundled-db exec -T mysql sh -c 'MYSQL_PWD="$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" exec mysqldump --single-transaction --quick --routines --events --triggers --hex-blob --set-gtid-purged=OFF -uroot peanut_admin' | gzip -9 > /www/docker/peanut-admin/backups/<backup_id>/database.sql.gz
backup_method.checksum_file: after manifest.json is complete, run sha256sum database.sql.gz php-storage.tar.gz manifest.json > SHA256SUMS from the exact backup directory
backup_method.ordering: prepare target; quiesce and verify application writers; dump database; archive php-storage; write manifest and checksums; verify artifacts; resume services; run origin and public health checks

manifest_required_fields: deployment, database, application and backup stable resource IDs
database name and php-storage volume name
PHP, Nginx and MySQL image references and digests
artifact filenames, byte sizes and SHA-256 digests
backups.integrity_check: from the exact backup directory, run sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS, gzip -t database.sql.gz, and tar -tzf php-storage.tar.gz >/dev/null; SHA256SUMS covers database.sql.gz, php-storage.tar.gz and manifest.json

restore_check.artifact_precondition: the exact paired directory must pass all checksum, gzip and tar checks and its manifest resource IDs must match this production deployment
restore_check.policy: production restore is never part of a routine release and requires an explicit recovery gate; database.sql.gz and php-storage.tar.gz must be restored as one pair
restore_check.post_restore: PC32 verification runs only against peanut-admin-production-restore-verification-deployment: validate schema migration and representative Account/Tenant/TenantMember rows, restore the paired file volume, assert zero listeners and unchanged active targets, then remove only the successful isolated target; production recovery remains a separate explicitly authorized action

backups.freshness_requirement: each production update uses a new backup ID from the exact pre-update source commit; all four artifacts and checks must complete before the application write-quiescence window ends

health_check.tools: ssh -o BatchMode=yes oracle3 'command -v tar gzip sha256sum && cd /www/docker/peanut-admin && sudo -n docker compose -f compose.yaml --profile bundled-db exec -T mysql mysqldump --version'
health_check.source_bindings: ssh -o BatchMode=yes oracle3 'sudo -n docker volume inspect peanut-admin_mysql-data peanut-admin_php-storage'

backups.retention_policy: no automatic pruning; retain each verified pair until a newer verified pair exists, its release smoke has passed, and the production deployment owner explicitly approves deletion of the exact older backup ID
backups.cleanup_responsibility: Peanut Admin production deployment owner deletes only an explicitly approved backup ID directory; incomplete or failed sets remain isolated and require an explicit disposition decision
backups.backup_responsibility: Peanut Admin production deployment owner executes the registered paired backup method before destructive fresh reinstallation

queues.reason: the current product has no registered queue service

resources.purpose: isolated private Tencent COS bucket for unified storage acceptance
resources.credential_ref: deployment environment variable PEANUT_STORAGE_CREDENTIAL_MASTER_KEY; COS SecretId and SecretKey are entered through the Platform storage account API and persisted only as pa_storage_account encrypted ciphertext (no value is stored in Git or this registry)
resources.freshness_requirement: before a stateful rehearsal, claim this exact resource, verify the deployment master-key variable is present without printing it, configure an acceptance-only account and private Space, then use a unique tenant/file-key prefix
resources.health_check: after an active resource lease and Platform account configuration, use the Tencent COS SDK against this exact bucket to perform the scoped object write/read/delete rehearsal
resources.cleanup_responsibility: Peanut Admin storage acceptance owner deletes only the exact rehearsal object prefix after evidence capture
resources.backup_responsibility: not applicable; the bucket is empty and stores only disposable acceptance objects
resources.allocation_state: bucket allocated; deployment master-key variable and acceptance account credential entry are required before a stateful rehearsal
